decomposed_hypotheses.falsifiable_claim: The renderer tends to auto-complete a canonical 'traditional tofu workshop' inventory even when the requested task centers on one moment, producing checklist-like staging.
existing_support: RF1_A without R1C still presents multiple canonical workshop elements in legible positions; evaluator judged scene closer to proving 'this is a tofu workshop' than to an incidental work moment.
RF1_B shows the same tendency despite different reference condition.
Older tofu evidence repeatedly rewarded/contained complete process evidence and density.
counterevidence: The rice-granary historical sample also contained multiple semantically relevant props yet was judged more credible and less template-like.
Existing evidence does not show whether checklist completion comes from tofu topic priors or from the shared task wording asking to make the workshop identifiable.
decomposed_hypotheses.possible_r1c_interaction: R1C may amplify legibility and compositional solvedness, but M1 survives without R1C; R1C is not necessary.

minimal_test.intervention: Replace tofu-workshop semantic slot with matched rice-granary work-process slot while preserving sentence functions and evidence requirements.

decomposed_hypotheses.falsifiable_claim: The renderer homogenizes wear, age, residue and surface treatment into a coherent photogenic patina, reducing material heterogeneity.
existing_support: RF1 evaluator explicitly failed MATERIAL_HETEROGENEITY for both A and B.
Both candidates were described as sharing attractive aged-wood language and overly coherent surface treatment.
Golden differs by non-uniform dirt, moss, bark, leaf and moisture micro-variation.
counterevidence: Historical rice-granary sample was specifically praised for differentiation among rice, bamboo, linen and aged wood.
Therefore uniform patina is not universal across all outputs from the renderer.
decomposed_hypotheses.possible_r1c_interaction: R1C could strengthen coherent surface aesthetics, but A fails the same material gate without R1C; any R1C effect is non-necessary.

minimal_test.prerequisite: Use same non-tofu topic that failed a matched RF1-structure test; otherwise M2 cannot be isolated from topic.
minimal_test.intervention: Remove scene-organizing/evidence-display scaffold while keeping the same subject event and output geometry; do not add material realism instructions.
minimal_test.confirming_pattern: RF1-structure FAIL material heterogeneity + content-only structure PASS

decomposed_hypotheses.falsifiable_claim: The renderer injects a recurring atmosphere bundle—steam, side/window light, wet floor or sheen—to signal craft authenticity, creating cinematic rather than incidental lighting/material behavior.
existing_support: RF1 evaluator cites steam, wet floor and window/side light as a coordinated 'workshop atmosphere package' in A and stronger in B.
Prior tofu generations repeatedly used steam/wetness as authenticity cues.
counterevidence: Not every historical credible sample uses the same atmosphere bundle; the rice control's main noted issue was warm light rather than theatrical steam/wet-floor coupling.
The tofu process itself legitimately involves moisture and steam, so presence alone is not evidence; the causal question is coordinated beautifying use.
decomposed_hypotheses.possible_r1c_interaction: R1C may encourage stronger visual hierarchy and atmospheric coherence, but A demonstrates the bundle can appear without R1C.

minimal_test.intervention: Matched non-steam industrial/food-process topic substitution chosen from an existing credible subject family; do not prohibit steam or wetness explicitly.
minimal_test.confirming_pattern: bundle disappears and absolute realism passes in matched non-tofu task
minimal_test.disconfirming_pattern: cinematic atmosphere reappears despite topic substitution
minimal_test.note: Do not directly forbid steam/light/wet floor because that would add a new anti-AI rule and confound the mechanism.

decomposed_hypotheses.falsifiable_claim: The renderer arranges process evidence for viewer comprehension rather than letting a single production event causally determine occlusion, mess, crop and object placement.
existing_support: DOCUMENTARY_CAUSALITY failed for both RF1 arms.
Evaluator described foreground molds/cloth/apparatus as unobstructed and display-oriented, with multiple process cues simultaneously readable.
Golden is characterized by incidental occlusion and unresolved environmental evidence rather than explanatory arrangement.
counterevidence: Some readable process evidence is legitimate in documentary photography; the existing evaluator cannot quantify when legibility crosses into staging.
Historical rice sample had coherent near/mid/far reading and still looked more credible, so readable structure alone is not sufficient for failure.
decomposed_hypotheses.possible_r1c_interaction: R1C may enhance editorial hierarchy, but A shows display substitution without R1C; R1C is not required.

minimal_test.prerequisite: Same topic and renderer must be held fixed, ideally after a non-tofu Stage 1 failure.
minimal_test.intervention: Use a content-only request that states the event but removes instructions whose function is to make the place identifiable or to organize contextual evidence.
minimal_test.confirming_pattern: content-only PASS documentary causality while RF1-structure version FAILS

cross_mechanism_cautions: M1 and M3 are strongly topic-sensitive and can co-vary; do not test either by adding explicit prohibitions.
M2 and M4 are more directly testable by structure ablation, but only after topic is held fixed.
A single PASS can falsify sufficiency of some mechanisms but cannot establish sole causality.
A FAIL/FAIL chain cannot prove a general renderer prior without a future renderer-switch experiment.

frozen_next_experiment_contract.purpose: Distinguish topic-conditioned mechanisms from shared task-structure mechanisms before any renderer-switch test.

stage_1.stop_rule: If Stage 1 passes absolute realism, stop and do not run Stage 2.

stage_2_only_if_stage1_fails.stop_rule: Stop after evaluation regardless of result; no renderer switch under this contract.

preregistered_interpretation.interpretation: SHARED TASK-STRUCTURE MECHANISM FAMILY STRONGLY IMPLICATED
TOPIC AND TASK-STRUCTURE ABLATIONS DID NOT RESCUE REALISM; GENERAL RENDERER PRIOR REMAINS COMPATIBLE BUT UNPROVEN

required_checks: Stage 1 changes only topic content slot and preserves RF1 structure/function.
Stage 2 is strictly conditional on Stage 1 FAIL.
No explicit anti-AI, realism, negative-prompt, steam, patina, mess, occlusion or imperfection rules are added.
Maximum budget is 2 images, zero retry, conditional second image.
No result branch claims a sole or primary root cause beyond identifiability.
